name: OpenAI Whisper
knownFor: The widely used open speech-to-text model, plus OpenAI’s hosted transcription API and related ChatGPT voice features.
popCaption: 112,711 GitHub stars on openai/whisper (GitHub API, checked Nov 14, 2026). That counts the open model, not ChatGPT voice minutes.
pro: The most-cited open transcription model in this set, with a huge GitHub star count
con: Self-hosting needs hardware; the hosted API is a different, usage-based product
costCaption: The open Whisper model is free to run yourself. The official OpenAI transcription API is usage-based (per audio minute) and billed separately — no monthly total was invented. Rated Free for the open model. If you only use ChatGPT’s built-in voice features, those follow ChatGPT plan pricing instead.

name: Otter
knownFor: A meeting notetaker and transcription app for live calls, with a clear individual Pro plan.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Otter is one of the best-known dedicated meeting notetakers; no public seat-count was found.
learn: Meeting notes for individuals and small teams
pro: A dedicated meeting product with a published individual price
con: Popularity is editorial; the promotional prices on the page change
costCaption: Official otter.ai/pricing (checked Nov 2026): Pro $16.99/user/month, or $8.33/user/month when billed annually (the page also showed a promotional half-off monthly price; the band uses the regular $16.99 monthly figure). Business is listed at $30/user/month or $19.99–$24/user/month depending on the offer on the page. Rated on Pro monthly.

name: Deepgram
knownFor: A speech-to-text API aimed at products that need fast, accurate transcription at scale.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Deepgram is a widely cited STT API, not a consumer meeting app.
con: Usage-based billing; the cost band is an editorial estimate
costCaption: Deepgram is usage-based API pricing (typically per audio minute). No individual monthly seat was captured this session. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual API spend — no monthly total was invented. Confirm current rates on deepgram.com/pricing.

name: AssemblyAI
knownFor: A speech-to-text and audio-understanding API, including transcription, summaries, and related models.
learn: STT and audio understanding in an app
pro: A full audio API, not only raw transcripts
con: Usage-based billing; the cost band is an editorial estimate
costCaption: AssemblyAI is usage-based API pricing. No individual monthly seat was captured this session. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual API spend — no monthly total was invented. Confirm current rates on assemblyai.com/pricing.

name: Fireflies
knownFor: A meeting notetaker that joins calls, transcribes them, and shares notes with a team.
learn: Automatic meeting notes for a team
pro: A well-known notetaker that sits in the meeting itself
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Fireflies sells free and paid individual or team plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on fireflies.ai/pricing.

name: Fathom
knownFor: A meeting recorder and notetaker, known for a generous free tier and simple recap videos.
pro: A popular, straightforward notetaker with a well-known free tier
con: Official paid-plan price was not captured this session
costCaption: Fathom offers a free plan and paid upgrades. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $ for a typical individual paid plan. Confirm current prices on fathom.video.

name: Grain
knownFor: A meeting recorder aimed at clipping, sharing, and coaching from recorded calls, especially in sales teams.
pro: Built around highlights, not only a transcript dump
con: Official price was not captured this session
costCaption: Grain sells paid team plans. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$$ for a typical paid plan. Confirm current prices on grain.com/pricing.

name: Rev
knownFor: A transcription service that combines AI transcripts with optional human review, used when accuracy matters more than a meeting bot.
con: Pay-per-minute pricing; the cost band is an editorial estimate
costCaption: Rev is primarily pay-per-minute or per-job, with optional human transcription at a higher rate. No single monthly seat was used as the basis. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical light individual monthly spend — no total was invented. Confirm current rates on rev.com/pricing.

costCaption: Sold as part of Descript’s plans. This session did not capture a current official monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$$ for a typical individual creator plan. Confirm current prices on descript.com/pricing.
